# Contributing to Truffle

Truffle is PostHog's custom fork of [Trino](https://github.com/trinodb/trino).

## Safety & Public Repository Guidelines

Before opening an issue or pull request, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md). Never include customer data, internal identifiers, private endpoints, or secrets in issues, pull requests, tests, or commit messages.

## Contribution process

Open a pull request against `master` and follow the pull request template. Code style, build, and test conventions are in [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md). Changes that are not specific to PostHog's warehouse are usually better contributed to [upstream Trino](https://trino.io/development/process.html), which this fork merges regularly.
